business_scope.primary_industry_name: GPS-Sealed Bonded Road Feeder Service for International Airports

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (investment source jurisdiction; WFOE formed in mainland China)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) between Taiwan and Mainland China (2010)
Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion (2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of the People's Republic of China on Anti-Money Laundering (as amended, effective 1 January 2025); PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision); Regulations of the PRC on the Registration Administration of Companies; Enterprise Name Registration Administration Measures of SAMR.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) under the State Administration for Market Regulation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: notarized PRC Business License -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office apostille. Consular Legalization: notarized PRC Business License -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office authentication -> destination state consulate. These two paths are mutually exclusive; never perform them sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Enterprise Credit Information Public Report)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: enterprise credit information report printed from SAMR system and notarized -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office apostille. Consular Legalization: notarized report -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office authentication -> destination state consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel; never chain them.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney for Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed directors and shareholders executing the WFOE incorporation package
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: notarized execution page -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office apostille. Consular Legalization: notarized execution page -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office authentication -> destination state consulate. Use only the path required by the receiving state; never both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders and PRC legal counsel, approved and submitted to AMR
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: notarized Articles of Association -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office apostille. Consular Legalization: notarized Articles of Association -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office authentication -> destination state consulate. The two routes are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC licensed commercial bank holding or opening the WFOE's account (e.g., Bank of China or ICBC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille: bank-sealed letter notarized -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office apostille. Consular Legalization: bank-sealed letter notarized -> provincial Foreign Affairs Office authentication -> destination state consulate. Never combine apostille with consular legalization.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法) Articles 1, 2, 98–113, 128–131; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals (外國人投資條例) Articles 4–8; Act Governing Relations Between the People of the Taiwan Area and Mainland Area (臺灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例) and the Mainland Investment Permission Regulations (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce — Company Registration Division (經濟部商業司公司登記組), including its centralized and regional offices and the One-Stop Company Registration Online Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application (公司設立登記申請書) with approved Articles of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to a non-public limited liability company under Taiwan law. The MOEA and the Investment Commission require that the subscribed capital be fully paid into a Taiwan bank account and shown in a bank capital certificate. For mainland-funded investors the capital must be remitted in cash; no escrow account is mandated, but capital cannot be withdrawn prior to registration except for lawful incorporation expenses.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED: 1. That the subscription of the 1,000,000 ordinary shares at NT$10 par per share by the sole corporate shareholder, [PARENT NAME], is accepted and fully paid as evidenced by the bank capital certificate. 2. That the registered office of the Company shall be established at [TAIWAN ADDRESS], effective immediately. 3. That [PERSON A] is appointed as Chairman and Managing Director, and [PERSON B] is appointed as General Manager, with full authority to execute banking, licensing, and lease documents. 4. That officers shall open a bank account and file all incorporation, tax, and bonded transportation licenses. All directors assent. So resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議委員會)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Utilize the MOEA Investment Commission's online application system to submit the Foreign Investment or Mainland Investment approval application. Attach notarized corporate documents from the mainland investor (including the company's business license, articles of association, and board resolution authorizing establishment of the Taiwan WFOE), a detailed Taiwan investment plan setting out the capital amount, business scope (ISIC 5222 bonded truck fleet), and financing method. Pay application fees and obtain the written approval letter. Approval also constitutes the basis for subsequent company name pre-review and capital remittance.
required_dossiers: Notarized certificate of incorporation and articles of the mainland parent company (with Taiwanese representative office notarization or authenticated copies)
Parent company board resolution approving the Taiwan WFOE investment
Audited financial statements or bank credit report of the parent company
Taiwan WFOE investment plan and proposed business scope
Power of attorney appointing a Taiwan legal agent/resident
Passport/identification of the designated Taiwan responsible person
Bank reference letter for capital remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, respond to the Commission's deficiency notice within 30 days by amending the investment plan or providing further source-of-funds evidence. Appeal an adverse denial to the Executive Yuan within 60 days or restructure the investment through a third-region vehicle where legally permissible.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce – One-Stop Company Registration Portal (公司名稱及業務預查線上申請)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log onto the MOEA Company Registration One-Stop Portal and file the company name and business scope pre-approval application. Enter the proposed English and Chinese company names, select the exact business scope codes for 'Motor Freight Transport – Bonded Cargo Service', and attach a copy of the Investment Commission approval letter. Pay the filing fee (new Taiwan NT$300). The system checks against duplicate names and identical business scope wording.
required_dossiers: Company name and business scope pre-check application form
Proposed Chinese and English company names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name or scope is rejected, immediately refile with a substitute name or reduced scope. No formal administrative remedy is necessary because the applicant may file again without penalty; preserve the pre-approval certificate (valid for six months with extension).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Contribution and Bank Capital Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwanese commercial bank (company account branch) in coordination with the Central Bank Foreign Exchange Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Investment Commission approval and name pre-approval, open an NT$ account in the name of the proposed company at a Taiwan bank. Wire the approved capital amount from the mainland parent to this account, using the cross-strait remittance disclosure form. Upon receipt, instruct the bank to issue a capital contribution certificate (銀行存摺/存款餘額證明) showing the paid-in capital. The bank will also conduct know-your-customer due diligence on the beneficial owner.
required_dossiers: Parent board resolution on capital remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening due to KYC issues, submit a cross-strait remittance authorization and beneficial owner declarations; if the wire is returned due to exchange controls, correct the remittance reason code ('direct investment') and resubmit within the validity of the approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce – Company Registration Division (經濟部商業司公司登記組)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application online through the One-Stop Company Registration Portal. Attach the bank capital certificate, rent contract for registered office, the approved articles of incorporation, and the list of directors and shareholders. Pay the state registration fee (currently NT$1,000 for incorporation). The MOEA issues a Company Registration Certificate with a Unified Business Number. After registration, apply for the company chop/seal.
required_dossiers: Rental contract or proof of legal access to registered office
Shareholder and director list with copies of IDs
Statement of compliance signed by the legal agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is queried (e.g., deficient documents or discrepancy in capital certificate), remedy by filing a supplementary written explanation and corrected forms within 14 days. If the MOEA refuses, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days of service of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Labor Insurance, and NHI Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration (local tax office) and Bureau of Labor Insurance (勞工保險局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the Company Registration Certificate, file for Business Tax (VAT) registration and Uniform Invoice entitlement with the responsible National Taxation Administration office. Set up employer registration with the Bureau of Labor Insurance and the National Health Insurance Administration; establish payroll accounts within the statutory deadline to avoid late-filing penalties.
required_dossiers: Estimated monthly payroll for labor insurance declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office challenges the lease or business place, submit the principal-use inspection and remedial lease declaration; late registrations can be cured with a penalty payment at the administrative rate under the Tax Collection Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Customs Bonded Transporter License and Highway Carrier Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance Customs Administration (財政部關務署) and Directorate General of Highways, MOTC (交通部公路總局)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the local Highway Transport Office for a Road Freight Transport Business License (汽車貨運業). After receiving the license, register the truck fleet and obtain vehicle registration certificates. Submit the bonded transporter application to the Customs Administration, including guarantee/bond, the highway license, and relevant airport feeder route plan. For bonded airport feeder service, simultaneously apply for an airport access permit at the international airport cargo terminal. Obtain fire safety and structural load certificates for the assigned depot.
required_dossiers: Corporate registration certificate and Unified Business Number
List of vehicles with registration certificates
Bank guarantee or duty guarantee bond
Fire safety inspection certificate for warehouse/depot
Structural load inspection certificate for any loading platform
Occupational safety plan for operational personnel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Highway Authority imposes restrictions on fleet size, remedy by adjusting the planned fleet within the permit conditions; if Customs requests a higher bond, obtain an additional bank guarantee or increase the paid-up capital to satisfy the guarantee ceiling. Reconsideration requests are available to the Customs Administration within 15 days of an adverse decision.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Finance, Customs Administration (財政部關務署) in joint coordination with the Directorate General of Highways (公路總局), Ministry of Transportation and Communications
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Customs Bonded Transporter License (海關監管貨物運送人許可證) and Road Freight Transport Business License (汽車貨運業登記)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (環境部), Environmental Management Agency
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III – Exempt (low-impact road fleet service) provided the depot does not house refueling, vehicle washing, or painting installations exceeding small-quantity pollutant thresholds; any such installation requires an environmental registration or full EIA under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges to public sewers must comply with Taiwan effluent quality standards (pH 6–9; BOD≤30 mg/L; COD≤100 mg/L; SS≤30 mg/L); VOC emissions from any stationary painting or degreasing equipment must meet stationary-source emission limits under the Air Pollution Control Act; waste lubricant, oil filters, and tires must be surrendered to licensed waste disposal operators and manifests must be retained for at least two years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for all occupied premises (fire alarm, extinguishers, and escape routes), structural load report for the freight parking shed or warehouse floor, and workplace occupational clearances under the Occupational Safety and Health Act; bonded fleet must maintain valid vehicle safety inspection certificates and GPS-sealed cargo compartment seals.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (SAT) of the People's Republic of China, with e-filing through the Electronic Tax Bureau portal. Where the bonded feeder activity creates a fixed place of business or branch in Taiwan, the Ministry of Finance Taxation Administration of Taiwan and the Integrated Tax Filing Portal apply as secondary competent authorities; cross-strait income allocation and treaty relief are governed by the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Agreement.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Incorporate the WFOE at the Administration for Market Regulation and obtain the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which serves as the statutory taxpayer identification number. File the tax registration particulars within 30 days through the multi-license integration data exchange; submit the VAT general taxpayer election where planned annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5 million; procure the road freight operating license and customs bonded-fleet registration with GPS electronic sealing; activate electronic tax filing credentials and digital invoice quota; and, if operative, register a Taiwan branch taxpayer ID at the local National Taxation Bureau before commencing feeder services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise taxed on worldwide income under the Enterprise Income Tax Law at the standard 25% rate; no pass-through regime exists. Dividend distributions to the Taiwan shareholder attract withholding tax at 10%, reduced to 5% where the Taiwan corporate beneficial owner holds at least 25% of the WFOE equity for 12 months or more.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Chinese law. Available statutory elections include: (i) small-scale taxpayer status at the 3% statutory levy (temporarily reduced to 1%) against general VAT taxpayer status at the RMB 5 million revenue boundary; (ii) deemed profit-rate assessment for related-party cross-border transportation margins; (iii) explicit zero-rating election for international and cross-strait road feeder services under VAT Pilot Circular 36; and (iv) treaty-rate elections for dividends, interest, and royalties flowing to the Taiwan shareholder.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — PRC enterprise VAT for the mainland WFOE; Taiwan Business Tax at the 5% headline rate applies separately to any Taiwan fixed place of business, with zero-rating of export feeder services under the Taiwanese Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 of cumulative annual taxable sales in the PRC triggers mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. For a Taiwan branch, Business Tax registration is triggered where average monthly taxable turnover exceeds TWD 80,000 for goods or TWD 40,000 for services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory issuance of Fully Digitalized E-Invoices under Golden Tax Phase IV. Each bonded road transport invoice must be transmitted in real time to the SAT fiscal clearing platform via the Electronic Tax Bureau API, with automatic invoice-number stamping, dynamic quota verification, and real-time fiscal clearance before lawful use. A Taiwan branch must file through the Taiwan Integrated Tax Portal under the mandatory uniform electronic invoice system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated VAT applies to (i) goods physically carried out of PRC customs territory by the GPS-sealed bonded fleet, and (ii) PRC-sourced international road transportation and airport-feeder services connected to international air waybills in transit. Eligibility requires a valid export/bonded registration, electronic seal records showing departure from customs jurisdiction, and receipt of countervalue in foreign currency. Taiwan branch export feeder income is concurrently zero-rated in Taiwan under the Business Tax Act.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration with bonded transit endorsement
GPS electronic seal manifest and customs transport supervision docket
Bonded truck route ledger with trailer seal issuance records
Air waybill (master or house) for the connecting international airport feeder leg
Commercial invoice, transportation service contract, and vehicle/driver compliance certificates
Inbound foreign exchange receipt certificate from the Taiwan or third-country counterparty
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The SAT export refund engine cross-references every zero-rating claim against customs bonded-movement data, GPS seal logs, and foreign-exchange settlement records. Violations trigger refund clawback with late interest, administrative fines of 50% to 500% of the evaded amount under Tax Administration Law Article 63, fines of 100% to 500% for fraudulent refund claims under Article 66, revocation of export tax-refund qualification for up to three years, and criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 204 with imprisonment up to life for large-scale fraud. Taiwan-side fraudulent zero-rating is sanctioned under the Tax Evasion and Penalty Act with fines up to five times the evaded tax and possible suspension of business.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), with delegated foreign-exchange administration to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE); the Bank of China Taipei Branch acts as the offshore RMB clearing bank for Taiwan under the 2013 Cross-Strait Currency Clearing Arrangement; the General Administration of Customs (GACC) jointly monitors bonded-fleet flows with SAFE through the Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System and the Customs Electronic Payment platform.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket tax holiday applies to a standard WFOE in Taiwan. The main reliefs are: (1) an incremental R&D investment credit capped at 30% of the corporate income tax payable under the Statute for Industrial Innovation; (2) a 5% to 10% investment credit for qualifying expenditures on smart machinery and automated logistics equipment; (3) a 10-year net operating loss carryforward (Income Tax Act Art. 39); and (4) the domestic dividend exemption on profits derived from other Taiwanese profit-seeking enterprises (Income Tax Act Art. 42). The effective rate on undistributed profits is increased by a 5% retained-earnings surtax under the two-tier corporate tax system, which is economically relevant to any deferral of dividend distribution.
